headline: Congress Regional Lead Spends Entire Budget On High-Strength Industrial Superglue To Force Factions Together Before Top Leadership Visit
body:
Facing an urgent deadline to unify warring internal factions before a high-profile visit from the party's central leadership, a senior regional party strategist has reportedly spent the entirety of his event coordination budget on 400 liters of high-strength industrial epoxy. The regional lead, seen earlier this morning dragging massive crates of adhesive into the local party office, claims the move is a ‘structural necessity’ for party harmony.

“Traditional dialogue and mediation were just not providing the necessary permanence,” said the official’s personal secretary, who was seen wearing heavy-duty rubber gloves. “We realized that if we could physically bond the dissenting group leaders to the same conference room chairs, we could guarantee a display of unwavering consensus for at least the duration of the visit, if not for the next several fiscal quarters.”

Staff members have been instructed to apply the industrial-grade compound to all seats, armrests, and even the lapels of the opposing spokespersons' jackets. While some local workers have raised concerns about the long-term impact on furniture upholstery, the strategist remains unfazed, noting that the political optics of a perfectly immobile party are well worth the cost of replacing a few velvet cushions.

As of noon, the local office has reported that three district secretaries have already been successfully ‘integrated’ into the main committee bench. The party is now bracing for the central leadership visit, with plans to distribute non-toxic solvent packets to everyone involved, but only after the official photograph has been verified as unanimous.
caption: When ‘internal consensus’ becomes a literal physical reality. How far would you go to keep your team together? #Politics #Unity #Congress #Satire (satire)
igHook: Would you actually let them glue you to your seat to prove a point?
